story.head: Who blinks first?
paras: The Wild are 4-2-1. The Blues have won two in a row, the last a 7-2 rout of Ottawa.

It’s strength against strength: the Blues are the league’s best for chance quality, but the Wild are near the top at preventing dangerous shots. The Blues’ defensemen shoot a lot, and the Wild’s not so much.

items.text: The Wild are newly without Jared Spurgeon, have been without Marcus Foligno since Oct 8, and have had to make do without Filip Gustavsson and Brock Faber all season. Jesper Wallstedt is expected to start. Counting how much each missing player usually brings, no team is missing more right now.
Kirill Kaprizov has a point in six straight games against St. Louis, and 12 points in his last eight against them.
The Blues are newly without Pavel Buchnevich, and have had to make do without Logan Mailloux all season.
Pius Suter is two goals from 100.
